name: The World
overview: The Bible reveals that the world is both God’s creation and a place often opposed to Him and His followers. Jesus, who made the world, was not recognized by it, yet God’s love for the world is shown through the gift of His Son for eternal life. Believers are chosen out of the world and thus face its hatred, highlighting the tension between being in the world but not of it. Scripture also warns believers to be wise and watchful, recognizing the presence of evil and the coming end of the world.
